channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-120430 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Camaleon CMS before 2.9.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in Admin::CategoriesController that allows authenticated users to modify unauthorized categories by referencing arbitrary category IDs. Users authorized for one post type can send update or destroy requests pairing another category ID with their authorized post_type_id to rename or delete categories.

item.title: CVE-2026-120431 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.29, and 11.03 before 11.15.07 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in sgitopnm's readChannels() function when processing RLE-compressed SGI images. Attackers can supply crafted SGI files with oversized offset table lengths to write controlled data past the heap buffer, causing crashes or potential code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120432 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.02.30, and 11.15.08 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in winicontopam that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via oversized ICO/CUR dimensions. Attackers can supply a crafted icon file with width or height above 32767, wrapping int16_t loop counters into negative row buffer indices to cause crashes or potential code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120433 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the picttoppm paintPoly() function due to an unbounded polygon point count. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with a polygon exceeding 100 points to overwrite the fixed pts array, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120434 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains a stack-based buffer overflow in picttoppm's scanPoly() function in converter/ppm/picttoppm.c. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file whose polygon edges produce more than 5000 points, overflowing the coord stack array to crash the converter or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-120435 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains a heap buffer overflow in xpmtoppm caused by an unvalidated characters-per-pixel value in the XPM header. Attackers can supply a crafted XPM file with characters-per-pixel greater than 3 to overrun fixed 3-byte colorName hash entries, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120436 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains an integer overflow in jbigtopnm that causes heap buffer overflow when computing output buffer size. Attackers can supply a crafted multi-plane JBIG file with large header dimensions so jbg_dec_merge_planes() overflows the undersized buffer, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120437 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.30, and 11.03 before 11.15.08 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the tgatoppm converter's get_pixel() function that uses unchecked pixel values as color map indexes. Attackers can supply a crafted color-mapped Targa file whose pixel values exceed the declared color map bounds to crash the converter or leak adjacent memory into the output image.

item.title: CVE-2026-120438 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | QuickJS-NG before 0.16.0 contains an integer overflow in js_proxy_get_own_property_names() in quickjs.c that causes a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit hosts. Attackers running JavaScript can return a large array-like object from a Proxy ownKeys trap to wrap the allocation size, causing crashes or potential code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120439 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | QuickJS-NG before 0.16.0 contains an integer overflow in js_typed_array_sort() in quickjs.c that allows attackers to cause a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit hosts. Attackers who can run JavaScript can call TypedArray.prototype.sort with a comparator on a typed array near 2^30 elements, wrapping the allocation size and writing indices past the buffer to crash or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-120440 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | QuickJS-NG before 0.16.0 contains a memory leak vulnerability in js_atomics_store() in quickjs.c that fails to free the converted value when returning a RangeError. Attackers running JavaScript can repeatedly call Atomics.store with a valueOf that detaches or shrinks the buffer to exhaust heap memory and cause denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-120441 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | OwnTone Server through 29.3 contains an sql injection vulnerability in mpd_sticker_find() in src/mpd.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject SQL via the URI argument. Attackers can send a crafted 'sticker find song' command to the MPD listener on TCP port 6600 to bypass path restrictions and enumerate all media files with filesystem paths and metadata.

item.title: CVE-2026-120442 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | ape-volo-admin before 3.6.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key in appsettings.json. Attackers can sign tokens offline with the jti claim set to the seeded administrator id to gain full API control over users, roles, permissions and data.

item.title: CVE-2026-120443 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | GoFound through 1.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts by submitting document text to /api/index. Attackers can index malicious HTML that searcher/engine.go returns unescaped and dashboard.vue renders with v-html, executing script in an administrator's browser when an admin search matches the document.

item.title: CVE-2026-120444 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | GoFound through 1.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary directories by supplying ../ sequences in the database parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to /api/db/create and /api/db/drop, directly or via a victim's browser, triggering os.RemoveAll on directories outside the data directory.

item.title: CVE-2026-120445 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | madong-admin-saas through 5.1.4 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in AccessTokenMiddleware that allows authenticated tenant users to access the platform management API in multi-tenant mode. Attackers can reuse a tenant login JWT against /platformapi controllers to create platform administrator accounts, read tenant database settings, and take control of every tenant.

item.title: CVE-2026-120446 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | madong-admin-saas through 5.1.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the platform tenant management API because the 'platformapi' middleware key never matches the 'platform' application. Unauthenticated remote attackers can call /platformapi/tenant/account, bind-plan and sync-data endpoints to list, create, modify, disable or delete tenants and bind subscription plans.

item.title: CVE-2026-120447 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | HotGo through 2.15.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to choose the SMS login verification code by supplying the Code field to /admin/sms/send. Attackers who know a user's mobile number can set a known code and sign in through /admin/site/mobileLogin to take over accounts, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-120448 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | DoraCMS through 3.1.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/user/api-keys/:id endpoint that allows authenticated low-privileged users to rebind their API key to another user's account. Attackers can set the userId field on their own key to a victim's id, then act as that victim to modify profiles and publish or delete content.

item.title: CVE-2026-120449 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Outline before 1.12.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to read unpublished documents because the share loader ignores unpublished status. Attackers holding an existing share link can query shares.info, documents.info, or the /s/ share routes to read withdrawn content, while shares.revoke returns 404 and blocks revocation.

item.title: CVE-2026-120450 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | LaraDashboard 1.4.0 before 1.4.9 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with read-only email_template.view permission to send arbitrary emails via the MCP send-email tool. Attackers can mint an MCP token and call send-email with any recipient, subject, and raw HTML body to deliver phishing or spam from the site's mailer.

item.title: CVE-2026-120451 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0 | libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains stack-based and heap-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities in jl2005c_init() that allow malicious USB devices to corrupt memory by supplying an unbounded allocation table entry count. Attackers can connect a spoofed Jeilin JL2005B/C/D camera reporting 1022 or more entries to overwrite the saved return address and heap data, potentially achieving code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-120452 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.2
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.2 | libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in jl2005bcd_decompress() that allows malicious USB cameras to corrupt heap memory via oversized thumbnail processing. Attackers can supply small allocation-table values and a thumbnail header byte so in-place byte-swapping exceeds the buffer by about 30 KB, leaking heap contents in preview images.

item.title: CVE-2026-120453 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | The Sleuth Kit through 4.15.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in hfs_load_extended_attrs() in tsk/fs/hfs.c that reads the decmpfs header without checking attribute length. Attackers can supply a crafted HFS+ image with a com.apple.decmpfs attr_size of 1 to 15 to read past the allocation and crash analysis tools like istat or icat.

item.title: CVE-2026-120454 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | The Sleuth Kit through 4.15.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in decmpfs_decompress_lzvn_attr() that allows attackers to crash the tool by supplying a crafted HFS+ image. Attackers can set a huge uncompressed_size in an LZVN inline com.apple.decmpfs attribute so allocation fails and the decoder writes through NULL, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-120455 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | rapidyaml through 0.16.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ParseEngine::_add_annotation() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying YAML with excess anchors or tags. Attackers can submit YAML with consecutive anchors or tags to overflow the fixed two-element annotation array in release builds, corrupting stack memory and crashing the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-120456 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | L-SMASH through 2.14.5 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in isom_read_hdlr() and isom_read_dref_entry() in core/read.c triggered by oversized box sizes. Attackers can supply crafted MP4 or MOV files declaring hdlr or url box sizes larger than remaining data, stalling the stream position and corrupting heap memory to crash applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-120457 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | libaec through 1.1.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in m_se_decode() in src/decode.c that allows attackers to bypass a signed bounds check via an overlong fundamental sequence. Attackers can supply a crafted CCSDS 121.0/SZIP stream with 2^31 or more zero bits to crash the decoder or leak adjacent memory into decoded samples.

item.title: CVE-2026-120458 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Kvazaar through 2.3.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in read_header() in src/encmain.c that allows attackers to hang the command-line encoder by supplying a truncated Y4M header. Attackers can provide a crafted .y4m file lacking a terminating newline, causing unchecked EOF reads that hang the process indefinitely while consuming a full CPU core.

item.title: CVE-2026-120459 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | python-jose through 3.5.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge JWTs because HMACKey and CryptographyHMACKey accept zero-length HMAC secrets. When an application's HS256/HS384/HS512 verification key resolves to empty, such as an oct JWK with empty k, attackers can forge tokens with arbitrary claims that jwt.decode accepts.

item.title: CVE-2026-120460 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Jpom through 2.11.12 contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to manage other workspaces' Docker hosts by supplying foreign Docker asset ids. Attackers with Docker permission in any workspace can control containers, images, volumes and networks, including creating privileged containers with host bind mounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-120461 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Jpom through 2.11.12 contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass in POST /node/ssh_command/batch that resolves command templates and SSH nodes by ID without workspace filtering. Authenticated users with SSH command execute permission in one workspace can supply foreign template and node IDs to run commands on other workspaces' SSH hosts using their stored credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-120487 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | LaraDashboard before 1.4.5 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in SettingPolicy::manageCoreUpgrades() that allows non-Superadmin administrators with settings.edit to access Superadmin-only core-upgrade operations. Attackers can use the /admin/settings/core-upgrades backup, download, restore and upgrade actions to obtain database dumps containing password hashes and restore or upgrade the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-120488 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | LaraDashboard before 1.4.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with post.create or post.edit permission to inject scripts via unsanitized LaraBuilder design_json block content. Attackers can save text-editor, HTML, text or heading blocks containing script or event-handler markup that executes in administrator or Superadmin sessions viewing the builder, preview or page.

item.title: CVE-2026-120489 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Outline before 1.12.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in authorizeDocumentPublish() that allows authenticated members to publish documents into private collections without write access. Attackers can detach a child document via documents.unpublish, retaining parentDocumentId, then call documents.update with a private collection UUID to inject phishing content.

item.title: CVE-2026-120491 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Wing FTP Server before 8.2.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated web-client users to inject script by sending a crafted nowpath parameter to webclient/makethumb.html. Attackers can break out of the directory CDATA section in admin_get_lastconn.html XML to forge a connection id, which executes in administrators' browsers when admin_connection_list.html auto-refreshes, enabling Lua console abuse.

item.title: CVE-2026-120492 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Chainlit 2.12.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass path-scoped MCP allowed_urls entries because validate_mcp_url does not reject the semicolon character. Attackers can submit MCP URLs with '..;' segments to the /mcp endpoint, causing requests to paths outside the operator's grant on origins that strip semicolon path parameters.

item.title: CVE-2026-73695 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.16 contains a path traversal vulnerability in services/users/index.php, where an attacker-supplied module name is concatenated directly into an include path with no allowlist, basename(), or traversal sanitization. An attacker can supply directory traversal sequences in the module name to include arbitrary local .php files, resulting in local PHP file inclusion.

item.title: CVE-2026-73696 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.12 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability in the user panel authentication flow, where CWPUserIndex's unauthenticatedFlow() calls toLoginWithIntendedUri() which emits a redirect header without exit(), allowing PHP execution to continue and the module dispatcher include to run without authentication. Attackers with nothing more than a valid hosting username can bypass authentication to reach user-panel module code paths, enabling a pre-authentication chain to root access.

item.title: CVE-2026-73697 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.16 contains an arbitrary file write and OS command injection vulnerability in the phpini_editor user panel module. The acc=update action writes attacker-controlled content to an attacker-supplied path via file_put_contents with no path confinement, and the acc=addlabelphpiniadv action passes unsanitized attacker input into shell_exec without escaping. An attacker with access to the module can write arbitrary files and execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.
